name: DONUT
full_name: Direct Observation of the NU Tau
summary: DONUT at Fermilab made the first direct observation of tau-neutrino charged-current interactions using a prompt neutrino beam and a hybrid nuclear-emulsion detector.
detection_principle: An 800 GeV proton beam struck a dense target, producing charmed mesons and tau neutrinos through their decays. Emulsion sheets interleaved with target material resolved the short tau flight and decay kink; electronic tracking directed the microscope searches.

key_parameters.value: Hybrid nuclear emulsion with electronic trackers and spectrometer

results.summary: Resolved tau-decay topologies in neutrino interactions, directly identifying the third neutrino flavour.
Published an interaction cross-section measurement from the final sample.
